PURBASHA GRAMIN BANK
(A fictional bank) · Gaya Branch

Date: 9th October 2026

To,
Sujata Singh
19, Main Road, Gaya, Bihar - 823001

Sub: Reminder for overdue instalments in Loan Account No. 230991131243

Dear Customer,

This is to inform you that 2 EMI(s) of Rs. 12,450/- each in your above loan account are overdue since 8th August 2026. The total overdue amount is Rs. 24,900/-, and penal interest of Rs. 996/- has been levied as per the sanction terms.

You are requested to pay Rs. 25,896/- on or before 19th October 2026 to regularise the account.

Please note that if the dues are not cleared, the account will be classified as a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) on 6th November 2026, which will affect your credit score, and the Bank may initiate recovery proceedings as per law.

If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.

Yours faithfully,
Branch Manager
